_doc: Host caption pools (RICKY MARQUEE), read by runtime/src/ui/broadcast.ts. One line is picked per trigger (never the same line twice in a row per pool). Placeholders: {attacker} {victim} {winner} {loser} {name} {n}. priority: a higher value may interrupt a lower one on screen; minGapMs: the least time between two captions (KO / match lines ignore it). Lines stay short (CHANGED(UI) P2, verifier D6: the caption is a one-line ticker in the top band): <= 52 characters before names. CONTRACT section 8.

round_start: Cameras are hot, folks. Somebody hit somebody!
Round {n}! Keep your teeth inside your face!
We're live in five, four... oh, forget it. FIGHT!
The network paid for this set. Try to break all of it.
Round {n}! Nobody leaves until the ratings say so.
Studio audience, make some noise for pain!
final_round: Final round! Loser takes the ambulance.
One round, one winner, one huge medical bill.
Final round, folks. Our lawyers have left the building.
match_point: {name} is one round away from the episode!
Match point, {name}! Sponsors, are you watching?
first_blood: First hit, {attacker}! Tell the ratings desk!
{attacker} draws first! Put it on the reel!
{attacker} opens the account! Crowd loves it!
First touch, {attacker}! Save some for the ads.
counter: COUNTER! {victim} walked right into that one.
Caught! {attacker} reads it like a teleprompter.
{attacker} saw that coming from the parking lot!
punish: PUNISHED! {victim} will be feeling that in syndication.
You whiff on my show, you pay on my show!
Punish counter! That replay goes on a T-shirt.
perfect_parry: PERFECT PARRY! {attacker} just stopped time on live TV!
Did you see that? Neither did {victim}!
Frame perfect! The booth nerds are losing it.
{attacker} catches it clean! Somebody frame that!
throw_escape: Tech! Our contestants read the same script.
wall_splat: SPLAT! Somebody get a mop for that wall!
{victim} just became part of the set dressing!
Wall splat! That set cost us good money, {attacker}!
super: IT'S PRIME TIME! {attacker} cashes in the ratings!
Somebody cue the pyro! {attacker} goes big!
The money shot! {attacker} brings the house down!
Super! The sponsors just renewed for three more seasons!
stage_fright: STAGE FRIGHT! Get {name} a glass of water!
{name} is out of nerve! The lights are too bright!
Knees shaking, {name}? This is live TV!
comeback: Last sliver and {winner} takes it! Can't script it!
What a COMEBACK! The writers are furious!
{winner} was one hit from cancelled. Renewed!
From the grave to the top of the charts: {winner}!
ko: And {loser} is DOWN! That's a wrap on that one!
{winner} with the knockout! Roll the credits!
That leaves a mark. On the ratings. {winner}!
time_over: Time! We go to the judges' cards... which I wrote.
The clock beats them both! Let's check the damage.
Time's up! Nobody fell over, so we count the bruises.
perfect_round: PERFECT! {winner} didn't even get their hair messed up!
Not a scratch! {loser} looks like an extra!
Perfect! Check {loser} for a pulse... and a contract.
round_end: Round to {winner}! The advertisers want more!
{winner} takes the round! Stay tuned, folks.
One for {winner}! {loser} better find a second wind.
match_end: By popular demand and blunt force: {winner}!
{winner} takes the episode! Same time next week!
That is the show! {loser} gets carried out.
draw: A draw! Nobody wins, which means I win!
Dead even! The network hates a tie. Do it again!
boss_phase2: Commercial break's over. Now I'm in the ring.
You messed up my jacket. Now it's personal.
Phase two, kid. The host always has a phase two.
